description: This grouped bar chart illustrates scores across three different quality score categories. The horizontal category axis is labeled "Quality Scores" and displays three categories from left to right: IFD, TagNum, and DEITA. The vertical value axis is labeled "Scores" and uses a linear scale ranging from 30 to 70, with numeric tick marks at regular intervals of 5. The chart features grouped bars, with each category containing two adjacent bars. According to the legend, the light blue bars represent "$Avg_{obj}$" and the light orange bars represent "$Avg_{sub}$". Exact values are annotated above each bar. For the IFD category, the light blue bar is 63.98 and the light orange bar is 41.90. For the TagNum category, the light blue bar is 66.06 and the light orange bar is the shortest in the chart at 39.13. For the DEITA category, the light blue bar is the tallest in the chart at 67.64, and the light orange bar is 42.99. The chart also includes two horizontal dashed lines spanning the plot area: a blue dashed line (paired with a solid grey rectangle in the legend) positioned at 64.71, and an orange dashed line representing "Base $Avg_{sub}$" positioned at 37.91, with both exact values annotated on the far right side of the respective lines. The categories do not follow a strict alphabetical sorting, and all bars are visually emphasized with their exact numerical values printed directly above them.
